name: gqom_weight.show
desc: Weight — minimalist groovy gqom. kit.gqom_dark x arc.ghost_intro (C phrygian, cps 0.53) under genart.ferrofluid in lava. Gene loved this one (2026-07-16): sparse dark groove, space over density. Frozen snapshot of the exact code that played. Parametric recipe: assets/sets/set.weight.json
